- NFR-3: show two decimals "without converting it to a binary floating-point number"

The attempt-2 fix still holds: no capabilities_list citation, and the "no Figma connector" point cites org.design_library and record:brief.

Before rewriting the file in full, I re-read both contracted inputs (feat.prd and org.design_library) in this session. - ASCII low-fidelity wireframes for the populated and empty table
- synthetic data rules and a labelled dataset
- a Figma Make prompt with the basis of each rule
- a check against the PRD acceptance criteria and NFRs, and against the decision log

judge.notes:
The refusal reason is fixed: the output no longer cites file:ap_portal/src/ap_portal/index.js or any other ap_portal file.

Grounding:
- All 4 design-library rules (DL-1 to DL-4) are quoted word for word from org.design_library.
- The 5 states map correctly to feat.prd: AC-17, AC-19, AC-20 and AC-21 for the states, and AC-16 with P-A2 for the tie-break.
- The PRD check cites the right IDs for US-1, AC-13 to AC-21, NFR-1 to NFR-3, NFR-6, NFR-7, NFR-10 and OQ-B8 to OQ-B10.
- The carried open questions match PRD section 6 exactly: OQ-B1 to OQ-B10, PQ-1 to PQ-6, FQ-3, FQ-5 and FQ-6, OQ-1 to OQ-5 and Q-1 to Q-5.
- Repository and function placement is supported by the PRD section headers: ap_pipeline for the feed and delays, ap_forecast for vendor_risk, ap_aging for overdue_with_risk and ap_portal for renderOverdueRisk.
- The decisions applied (D-2026-031, D-2026-044, D-2026-050) and lessons (L-007, L-011) match MEMORY.md.
- The synthetic dataset is internally consistent. It is ordered 75, 42, 42, 31, and the tie at 42 puts SYN-INV-002 before SYN-INV-003, which is ascending order. The boundary row at exactly 30 days and the paid row are excluded, as AC-14 and AC-15 require.
- Presentation choices are labelled as agent judgement: greyscale, right-aligned amounts, margin annotations and no row actions.

Defects:
- SD-1 is attributed to record:brief and to a "G8" rule that appears in no source. This is the only real grounding defect.
- The Figma Make prompt states the "id ascending" tie-break as a firm rule. Assumption P-A2 is flagged only in the table of rule sources, not in the prompt itself (minor).

Completeness and usefulness:
- No real FigJam or Figma artefact was produced. The output justifies this with the design library's "Figma is not connected" line and the brief's api:github-only connector, and gives text wireframes, Mermaid flows and a ready-to-paste Figma Make prompt instead.
- Synthetic data rules were not among the inputs. The agent flags this correctly as PQ-P5.
- Loading and error states are absent from the PRD and are flagged as PQ-P3.
- Overall the output meets the "Low Fidelity Wireframes" outcome and checks itself against the PRD as the workbook action asks.
